title: The Full Canopy
notes: The Tree of Life is complete: every Crown of every class can be grown. The last 37 are the Jester's and the Drider's.

Jester: Three-Ring Circus, The Fool's Parade, Showstopper, Usurper's Crown, The Fool Is King, Weighted, Delthius's Smile, Royal Flush, Full House, Card Storm, Standing Ovation, Laughingstock, Roast of the Century, Encore from the Grave (a killing blow leaves you a laughing skeleton until you get a kill), Bone Storm, Headless Fool (your head casts along with you), Divine Fool, Lucky Disaster, The Fool's Errand (a silly task each Ascension), The Rules Are Wrong, Everyone's a Fool and King of Fools.

Drider: Ossuary, Bone Colossus, Lord of the Grave, Queen's Guard, Hive Mind, Apex Hunt, Eight-Fold Strike, Ambush Queen, Toxic Tide, Wrapped, Endless Web, Puppeteer, Brood Unbreakable, Matriarch's Will and Venom Brood.
